ipadp_role.description: Sits between the upstream Firebird C/C++ client library (FirebirdSQL/firebird releases) and downstream consumers (doctrine-firebird-driver, native package channels). Translates the Firebird OO API (IProvider/IAttachment/ITransaction) into PHP procedural (fbird_*) and OOP (Firebird\*) layers.

connects.interface: C/C++ client library (libfbclient), OO API headers (Interface.h, IdlFbInterfaces.h)
fbird_* procedural functions + Firebird\ OOP classes
GitHub release assets (.deb/.rpm/.apk) -> signed native package repositories
connects.spec: packages.auc.de (staging, Tier B) and packages.satware.com (production, Tier D); staging install verification runs in .github/workflows/packages-linux.yml

upstream.relationship: SDD methodology provider: methodology and tooling this repo conforms to

upstream.relationship: client library provider (libfbclient, OO API headers Interface.h/IdlFbInterfaces.h); supported 3.0/4.0/5.0+ via FB_API_VER conditionals
Zend Engine API reference (read-only: resource lifecycle, list destructors, executor globals semantics); supported branches PHP-8.2 through PHP-8.5

downstream.relationship: primary DBAL consumer of the fbird_* procedural layer and Firebird\ OOP classes
split stubs package: consumer-facing PHP signature surface, generated from stubs/ by the Split Packages job of this repo's release pipeline (tag-synced)
PIE split package: pdo_fbird/ subdirectory (fbird: DSN prefix driver) split out by this repo's release pipeline (tag-synced)
Symfony entity layer consuming the extension (private repo; identity redacted per IPADP privacy boundary)

publishes signed native .deb/.rpm/.apk packages built from php-firebird GitHub release assets to packages.auc.de (staging) and packages.satware.com (production); its staging host is the Tier B verification target exercised by .github/workflows/packages-linux.yml. Operating repos are internal and deliberately unnamed here (public-to-private link forbidden); coordination via public GitHub issues on this repo

privacy.notes: php-firebird is a public GitHub repo. Private downstream/consumer identities are redacted (forge-level disclosure only, per the _private_downstream precedent). The packages.auc.de / packages.satware.com host names are public material (referenced by .github/workflows/packages-linux.yml and issue #571); the internal repos operating them are not named in this file. 2026-10-25 audit: removed private repo-name mentions from packages-linux.yml comments.
